title: refactor(cart): extract Cart._subtotal
body: Cart.total mixed summing the items with applying the discount. This pulls the sum into its own _subtotal method so the discount rule reads on its own.
author: acme-dev

files.patch:
@@ -3,7 +3,10 @@ class Cart:
         self.items = items
 
     def total(self):
-        subtotal = sum(item.price * item.qty for item in self.items)
+        subtotal = self._subtotal()
         if subtotal > 100:
             subtotal *= 0.95
         return round(subtotal, 2)
+
+    def _subtotal(self):
+        return sum(item.price * item.qty for item in self.items)
